interpretation_boundary: The historical responses and original analyses belong to the kernel-v1 era.
The existing v9 backfill is not v9 operating on stored kernel-v1 states.
It is a replay of historical numeric token observations through the current recertified kernel followed by v6 and v9.
The current results cannot isolate observer-version effects from kernel-version effects.
A matched comparison requires the same token observations to be replayed through an exactly reconstructed kernel v1 and the current kernel while holding v9 fixed.
